texts.label: תרגום לאנגלית
texts.citation: Moshe Gil, Documents of the Jewish Pious Foundations from the Cairo Geniza (Leiden: Brill, 1976).
texts.html:
Recto

I:

  1. Thursday:
  2. 2 workers in clay, ½ (?). Oakum, 6. Nāshūsh, 2.
  3. Meal for the special masons, 2½, 4 helpers, 12½.
  4. 1 ḥiml lime, 6½. Masons, 10.
  5. Their helper, one day, 2. A worker in gypsum, ½.
  6. A gutter, 3. Their mason, 1
  7. (Total) 46.
  8. Friday:
  9. 1 ḥiml floor tiles, ½. 1 helper, ½.
  10. A worker in gypsum, 1 nisf. A meal, ½.
  11. Pavers, 10. AI-Qamala (?), 3½.
  12. The master, 7. Their apprentice, 1.
  13. Their meal, 1½. Ghālib, 4
  14. A helper, 3½.
  15. In gold, 1 nisf.
  16. Waraq, 32½.
  17. Sunday:
  18. Helpers, 7½. Oakum, 6.
  19. Workers in clay, 10. Clay, 4.
  20. Palm branches, 1. Masons, 10.
  21. (Total) 38½.
  22. Monday:
  23. Masons, 10. 3 helpers, 8.
  24. Cutting of floor tiles, 1. Meal of the special masons, 5½.
  25. A worker in lime, 6½. A worker in lime, 6.
  26. A worker in gypsum, 1 nisf. (Total,) in gold, 1 nisf.
  27. (In waraq,) 37.

II:

 

  1. Tuesday:
  2. Pebbles, 6. A worker in lime, 6½.
  3. Workers in lime, 12. 3 pavers, 10½.
  4. Helpers, 7. Clay, 5.
  5. Masons, 10. Workers in clay, 9.
  6. Ghālib, 3½. His meal, ½.
  7. Gypsum, 1 nisf. (Total,) in gold, 1 nisf.
  8. (In waraq,) 70.
  9. Wednesday:
  10. Workers in lime, 11½. Pavers, 7.
  11. (11-12) Helpers, 6. Meal for Ghālib, ½. (Total,) 25.
  12.  
  13. Thursday:
  14. A worker in lime, 7. Floor tiles, 3½.
  15. Ghālib, 3½, Pavers and a helper, 13.
  16. Pebbles, 6. A helper, 4.
  17. Gypsum, 1 nisf. Workers in clay, 9.
  18. (Total,) in gold, 1 nisf.
  19. In waraq, 46.
  20. Friday:
  21. A worker in gypsum, 1. Oakum, 3.
  22. A karrākh, 4½. A meal, 1½
  23. Twigs, 7. A carpenter ….

Verso

III:

  1. Record of sums spent by al-Shaykh Abūʾl-Surūr
  2. as he found it necessary:
  3. To Wafā, 1 dinar. To Yehūdā and Ghālib, 8.
  4. Lime, including transportation, 2. Slaking of lime and depositing of wood, 20.
  5. Workers in clay, 11. Slaking of lime, ½.
  6. 3 ḥimls of pebbles, 4½. Ghālib, 3.
  7. Gypsum and other things, 21½. A helper, 3½.
  8. Their meal, 1. Slaking of lime, ½.
  9. A worker in lime, 4. A helper, 3½.
  10. Their meal, 1. Oakum, 3½.
  11. Total, in gold, 1 dinar.
  12. (In waraq) 86½.
  13. Plus,
  14. the edge of the grating, 1¼. Blocking up of the door, 3.
  15. A carpenter, 4. 1½ raṭl nails, 4.
  16. His meal, ½. (Total,) 12¾.
  17. Transportation of wood and its unloading, 14½.
  18. Total, 15.
